evidence.decision: Assigns text roles before sizes, chooses runtime/system versus custom accommodations and specifies hierarchy-preserving reflow rather than aggressive truncation.
evidence.artifact: Delivers corrected type roles and resizing rules or implementation with supported-size examples.
evidence.transformation: Book list replaces fixed thin one-line titles/tiny status glyphs with legible wrapping rows, stacked support and scaled meaningful glyphs.
evidence.verification: Checks essential clipping/full-text routes, collapsed hierarchy and broken Bold Text; records actual sizes without claiming native shaping/distance comfort.
evidence.applicability: Preserves macOS no-Dynamic-Type distinction, spatial 2D/New York styles and Watch typography rather than promising identical APIs everywhere.
evidence.handoffs: Uses Layout for reflow, Accessibility for whole-task access and Right to left for mixed-script alignment.
evidence.distinctiveness: Text hierarchy under enlargement, custom-font equivalence and content-priority scaling determine the produced typography system.
